motion: Rain falls softly, the moon Momo smiles and glows a little warmer, the camera drifts very slowly towards the warm round window.
Lumi rocks very slowly in her chair hugging Twinkle, the fire flickers softly, rain slides down the window.
loop: Lumi rocks very slowly back and forth in the rocking chair, breathing calmly, Twinkle glowing softly; the fire flickers gently.

motion: Pip waddles in slowly with his candle, his long scarf trailing; Lumi looks up with a small happy smile.
Steam curls slowly from the teapot and cups, Lumi and Pip sip their tea slowly and blink sleepily.
loop: Soft steam curls up from the teapot and cups, Lumi and Pip breathe slowly and blink sleepily, the fire flickers gently.

motion: Mo turns once very slowly and settles into a round ball, his tail wrapping around him, his eyes closing.
loop: Mo sleeps curled up in a round ball, his body rising and falling slowly with each breath, the fire flickering softly beside him.

motion: Rain drops slide slowly down the round window, the moon Momo glows gently, wisteria sways a tiny bit.
loop: Rain drops slide slowly down the glass, the moon Momo glows calmly, the wisteria outside sways very gently.

motion: Lumi gives one slow soft yawn and hugs Twinkle closer, Twinkle glows a little warmer.
The three friends snuggle closer under the blanket, breathing slowly, the night light glowing softly.
loop: Lumi, Pip and Mo breathe slowly under the blanket, the star night light glows softly, the fire flickers low.

motion: Lumi's eyes close slowly, her breathing becomes slow and deep, the room light becomes slightly dimmer and warmer.
loop: Lumi sleeps peacefully, her chest rising and falling slowly, Twinkle glowing softly in her arms.

motion: Everyone sleeps, the fire glows low, rain slides down the window, almost nothing moves.
loop: Everyone sleeps peacefully, breathing slowly, the fire glows low and steady, rain slides softly down the window.
